subject: Microcommit tiering and procurement trigger
messages:
From: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@medixai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@medixai.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter capacity uplift — what are our options?

Hi Dylan / Ben,

Quick note from finance / platform — we're seeing a sustained 30% increase in inference volume vs our committed run-rate for Q2. If this trend holds we'll blow past our committed units in ~6 weeks.

Before I loop procurement: can you outline what a short-term uplift would look like mid-contract? Specifically:
- Pricing options for +30% tokens across the remaining 8 months of our annual term (do you offer a micro-commit tier vs top-up credit?)
- Whether we can co-term the uplift to our existing renewal date or if it becomes a separate line item
- Typical lead-time/legal items for a PO + amendment (our procurement needs 45–60 days notice for changes)

I've attached our May usage snapshot to make numbers concrete (MedixAI_usage_report_May2027.csv). Carlos is looping finance and will coordinate PO timing.

Thanks — we need to get a proposal into procurement this week if possible.

— Elena
Director of ML Platforms | MedixAI

Attachment: MedixAI_usage_report_May2027.csv
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@medixai.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@medixai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter capacity uplift — what are our options?

Elena — thanks for the heads-up and for the usage file. This is a pretty common mid-contract scenario, we can move quickly. High-level options:

1) Micro-commit tier (recommended for expected sustained growth)
   - Add a temporary committed band that sits between your current commit and the next full tier.
   - Discount: we typically offer 8–12% off hosted list for micro-commit bands depending on absolute units (see table below).
   - Billing: monthly in arrears; can be co-termed to your existing agreement so renewals remain aligned.

2) Ad-hoc top-up credits (fast, no amendment)
   - Pay-as-you-go top-ups at a small premium to committed rate (~+15% relative to commit price).
   - No amendment required, but cost-per-token is higher.

Practical items / ask from your side:
- Can you confirm expected monthly token delta (approx tokens/month) so we can pin exact pricing?
- Will procurement require an amendment signature (DocuSign) vs a PO referencing a purchase order?

I've drafted a one-page amendment (proposed_amendment_v1.pdf) that reflects a micro-commit option co-termed to your current 2028-01-15 renewal. Ben / Kimberly — flag if the discount band below is unreasonable given MDX-4381.

Proposed discount guidance (placeholder):
- +0–25% uplift vs current: 8% off committed rate
- 25–50% uplift: 10% off committed rate
- >50% uplift: 12% off committed rate + capacity prioritization

Happy to hop on a quick call today to walk through the amendment and procurement timing — I can prepare a DocuSign link once we lock numbers.

Best,
Dylan
Account Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MedixAI uplift — discount sanity check

Dylan / Kim — quick internal read:
- The discount bands you listed are fine as a starting point. For a strategic account like MedixAI we should be comfortable at the 10% mark for a persistent ~30% uplift.
- Legal will need at least a 3-week turnaround on the amendment redline; procurement's 45–60 day requirement could be an issue if they truly need all approvals in place.
- Suggest offering a bridge: a 60-day interim top-up credit at the higher per-token rate while legal finalizes the amendment (keeps their apps running without immediate financial surprise).

If they accept the interim credit -> amendment path, we can be flexible on effective date (amendment backdated to cover the interim billing window).

Ben
VP, Growth | Redwood Inference
From: Carlos Vega <c.vega@medixai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter capacity uplift — what are our options?

Thanks, team. A couple of clarifications from procurement / finance after reviewing the usage file: 

- Expected delta: ~+28% month-over-month for the next 3 months (conservative).
- Procurement needs an amendment and will issue a PO; their standard internal SLA is 60 days but they can fast-track to 30 days with executive approval.
- Finance prefers invoices split monthly (we don't do quarterly lumps) — not sure if you can support that with an amendment.

MedixAI is happy to accept the micro-commit approach if we can get: 
- A firm 10% discount band for the +25–50% uplift bracket
- Co-term the micro-commit to our Jan 15, 2028 renewal
- DocuSign + PO workflow; Medix legal will countersign.

If you can convert the proposed_amendment_v1.pdf into a DocuSign package with billing split language mocked up, we can attempt the 30-day procurement fast-track.

— Carlos
Director, Finance | MedixAI
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@medixai.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@medixai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter capacity uplift — what are our options?

Carlos / Elena — great, thank you for the clarity. Summary of agreed path and next steps: 

Agreed commercial terms (subject to final amendment):
- Approach: Micro-commit tier co-termed to existing contract (renewal 2028-01-15).
- Discount: 10% off committed rate applied to the uplift band (+25–50% uplift).
- Billing: Monthly invoices, billed in arrears; Redwood will accept PO references and MedixAI will provide the PO once DocuSign is complete.
- Interim: If the amendment is still in legal at invoice time, MedixAI may be billed for the interim top-up credit rate (15% premium) which will be reconciled/credit-applied once amendment is signed and backdated.

Operational items / deliverables from Redwood:
- I attached the updated amendment incorporating the billing split language and the specific 10% uplift band (proposed_amendment_v1.pdf).
- DocuSign package (link below) — please route to Medix legal for countersignature.
- HubSpot deal updated: MDX-2027-EXP-4381 (https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/MDX-4381).

DocuSign link (expires in 14 days): https://docusign.net/REDWOOD/MDX-4381-amendment

Next steps (quick):
1) Elena: route DocuSign to Medix legal and loop in procurement for PO timing (target 30-day fast-track).
2) Carlos: share PO number in reply to this thread once available.
3) Ben / Kimberly: confirm final legal redline cutoff (we'll stand by for any minor edits; large redlines will push timelines).

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to run through the amendment live.

Thanks — Dylan
Account Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf
